bio.text: Stewart Cathey Jr. is a Republican who represents District 33 in the Louisiana Senate, to which he was first elected in 2019.
He qualified in August 2026 as a candidate for Louisiana's 5th Congressional District.
He chairs the Senate Committee on Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development.
He is a lieutenant colonel in the U.S. Army Reserve, and in announcing his candidacy he described himself as a combat veteran.
